findings: `learner.overview.text` presents the weapon-container interpretation as “its older graphic history,” which implies an established historical origin despite the entry’s own account that this is only a received dictionary interpretation, unconfirmed by early glyph evidence. Replace that clause with an explicit qualification such as “A traditional dictionary interprets the graph as an arrow inside a weapon container, but early glyph evidence does not confirm this.” Cite the existing supporting evidence IDs.

`learner.components[1].text` omits the documented competing sound analysis of 矢. Since this component is also assigned the phonetic role and has a displayed modern reading pair that does not establish the historical relation, briefly note that a separate historical account proposes a sound role but it is unconfirmed. Cite the existing evidence IDs supporting the proposal and limitation.
